itn_cases.note: ITN cases are tested by the Go suite (transcriptcleanup_test.go) once the cgo gateway path ships. The Swift path (ITNProcessor.swift) uses the prebuilt XCFramework and is tested via manual TestFlight. Always-on for engine=other, language=en; identity for engine=whisper or non-English.

guarded_false_positives.note: Library ordinal tagger fires on fraction denominators ('one third' → '4th of a cup'). Guarded by ITNProcessor.protectFractions(). Upstream issue #82.

deferred_categories.reason: Email tagger eats preceding word ('email dom at ...' → 'emaildom@...'). Upstream to fix.
Phone parsing unreliable on naturally spoken numbers.
Library default converts 'give me a second' → 'give me a 2nd'. Always call with disableBareSecond: true.

my_words_cases.note: My Words Levenshtein correction (MyWordsCorrector.swift) — on-device path only. Tested manually via TestFlight with Parakeet. Swift-only; no Go equivalent. Guards: scoreThreshold=0.30, ambiguityMargin=0.05, minTokenLength=3, commonWords filter.

covered.note: Exact case-insensitive match (score=0.0) restores canonical casing.
Leading/trailing punctuation stripped before comparison, restored after.

guarded_false_positives.note: 'a' is in commonWords — never replaced. Without this guard 'a' → 'Ava' (score=0.67, rejected anyway, but guard fires first).
'ana' scores 0.25 against both 'Anna' and 'Anya' — ambiguity margin < 0.05, no replacement.
No token within 0.30 normalized distance of 'Ondrej'.
Multi-word My Words are skipped by the single-token pass.
